settings.title: Settings
settings.domain_already_used_in_traefik: Host name already used by another application
settings.role_master: Main server of a multi-server installation
settings.role_worker: Additional mailbox server: join a main server
settings.role_standalone_description: One complete Carbonio server: directory, mail transfer, mailboxes, webmail and the IMAP, POP3 and SMTP services of this node.
settings.role_master_description: A complete Carbonio server that other servers can join. It publishes the directory and mailbox ports on the cluster VPN only.
settings.role_worker_description: Hosts more mailboxes for a main server, on another node. It uses the directory and the mail transfer of the main server.
settings.no_masters_description: Configure an instance of Carbonio on another node as main server first, with new servers accepted.
settings.host_helper: Webmail address, SMTP name and Carbonio server name. It cannot change later.
settings.mail_domain_helper: Created with the administrator account. Add more domains in the Admin Panel.
settings.admin_password_helper: At least 10 characters. Spaces, quotes, $, ` and \ are not allowed.
settings.lets_encrypt_tips: The certificate is also used by SMTP, IMAP and POP3.
settings.antivirus_tooltip: Scans incoming and outgoing mail for viruses.
settings.antivirus_ram: The antivirus needs about 1.3 GiB of RAM. Carbonio needs about 4 GiB with it, 3 GiB without it.
settings.coming_soon_tooltip: Planned for a later release, as an optional add-on. It needs several GiB of RAM.
settings.admin_host_helper: Optional: a second host name that opens the Carbonio Admin Panel. Leave empty to reach it only from the node.
settings.mailbox_heap_mb_helper: Java heap of the mailbox service. Raise it for many users.
settings.timezone: Default time zone of new accounts
settings.first_setup_description: The first configuration installs Carbonio: it takes 5 to 10 minutes.
settings.host_cannot_change: The host name cannot change after the first setup
settings.admin_host_is_host: Use a host name different from the webmail one
settings.cluster_role_cannot_change: An additional server cannot change its role, and a server cannot become one
settings.join_not_found: This main server does not exist or does not accept new servers
settings.join_release_mismatch: The main server runs another Carbonio release: update both first
settings.mail_domain_cannot_change: The first mail domain cannot change
settings.mail_module_on_node: Another mail application uses the mail ports of this node: {value}
settings.mail_port_in_use: These mail ports are in use on this node: {value}
settings.cluster_port_in_use: These ports are in use on this node: {value}
